id.description: Names the brief to write to; one that is not the buyer's answers `not_found`.

narrative.description: Replaces the whole narrative, never appends to it.

domain.description: Names the domain `specs` and `remove` below sit under.

key.description: Names the key from the domain read; `price` is a key every domain has.

op.description: Sends the operator the domain read listed for this key.

value.description: Sends the desired value, typed by the key's type.

currency.description: Required on money: sil holds no exchange rate, so the bound is tested against offers in this currency only, and `eur` matches no offer sil stores.

reason.description: Writes the buyer's own words behind the row, and reads them back before proposing to relax it.

specs.description: Replaces every spec on the keys they name under that domain; a range is the two rows on its key.

items.description: Names a key whose specs go.

remove.description: Drops the specs on these keys when the buyer gives a row up.

decision.description: Logs in one sentence what the buyer changed and why; sil stamps it with the time, and the next session reads the reasoning rather than re-asking.

status.description: Closes the brief when the job is over.
